ClinGen_allele_ID.description: ClinGen Allele ID for cross table refrence

GREGoR_ClinVar_SCV.description:
ClinVar accession number for the variant curation submitted by your center

Notes: Field to be updated in subsequent data submissions. TBD requirement timeline. Currently optional, to consider whether required if already submitted.

GREGoR_variant_classification.description:
Clinical significance of variant described to condition listed as determined by the RC's variant curation.

Notes: Field to be updated in subsequent data submissions. TBD requirement timeline. Currently optional, to consider whether required if known disease gene.

VRS_ID.description:
The Variation Representation Specification (VRS, pronounced “verse”) is a standard developed by the Global Alliance for Genomic Health to facilitate and improve sharing of genetic information.

Notes: https://vrs.ga4gh.org/en/stable/
 doi:10.1016/j.xgen.2021.100027

items.description: List of related participant IDs carrying the same variant

allele_balance_or_heteroplasmy_percentag.description:
Reported allele balance (mosaic) or heteroplasmy percentage (mitochondrial)

Notes: Option reporting of allele balance for mosaic or mitochondrial variants. 
- If the variant is found mosaic in a parent sample, use the free notes line 36 to report parental allele balance.

alt.x-required-condition: CONDITIONAL (variant_type = SNV, variant_type = INDEL, variant_type = RE)

chrom.x-required-condition: CONDITIONAL (variant_type = SNV, variant_type = INDEL, variant_type = RE)

chrom_end.description:
End position chromosome of SV

Notes: Optional field to report second chromosome in SV

condition_id.description:
MONDO/OMIM number for condition used for variant interpretation.

Notes: Only list a MONDO or OMIM ID if the patient's phenotype and inheritance is consistent with the established disease mechanism and gene-phenotype association.

items.description:
Description of the expected inheritance of condition used for variant interpretation

Notes: Inheritance description should match the OMIM or MONDO entry listed in line 26. 
- If multiple inheritance types listed in OMIM/MONDO, select that which is suspected for this proband
- In cases where multiple inheritance patterns are being considered, it is possible to select multiple here

copy_number.description:
CNV copy number

Notes: To indicate copy number for CNVs that aren't covered by DUP or DEL, such as a triplication

items.description:
The experiment table and experiment ID(s) in which discovery was identified: experiment_table.id_in_table. Should correspond to an experiment_id in the DCC-generated experiment table.

Notes: RC submitted. 
- If experiment identifier is not available due to current data model limitations, use the 'method_of_discovery' field
- If variant is identified in multiple datasets, list the assigned primary experiment_id first and fill the following rows (e.g. allele balance) with data from this experiment
- Additional information on orthogonal experiments can noted in the 'method_of_discovery' or 'notes' field

gene_disease_validity.description:
Validity assessment of the gene-disease relationship

Notes: Gene-disease validity as defined by ClinGen framework. 
Each RC can lookup in GenCC (search.thegencc.org; PMID 35507016) or curate themselves. 
Acceptable to use unpublished evidence/case data if an RC would like to curate a novel gene-disease association.

gene_disease_validity_notes.description: additional context or explanation about the gene_disease_validity assessment

gene_known_for_phenotype.description:
Indicate if the gene listed is a candidate or known disease gene. Known disease genes can be identified using OMIM or MONDO or MitoMap. Variant/phenotype in proband should be consistent with the described MOD/phenotype to be considered a known gene for condition.

Notes: - Use OMIM or MONDO or MitoMap as truth source for known disease genes 
- Variant/phenotype/inheritance in the patient should be consistent with the disease entry to be considered 'Known', otherwise use 'Candidate' (e.g. phenotype expansions or novel phenotypes are considered 'Candidate' )

items.description:
HGNC approved symbol of the known or candidate gene(s) that are relevant for the observed phenotype.

Notes: - If the SNV/INDEL or RE is intergenic with no clear gene of interest, use 'intergenic'
- If the SV has multiple genes of interest, use a multi-value delimiter
- If the SV has no specific gene of interest, leave blank

gene_of_interest.x-required-condition: CONDITIONAL (variant_type = SNV, variant_type = INDEL, variant_type = RE)

genetic_findings_id.description:
Unique ID of this variant in this participant (primary key)

Notes: RC submitted unique variant ID
- Useful for tracking in downstream functional studies (i.e. V2F clickup database). 
- RC submitted but encourage conventional naming (genomic coordinate + participant id)

hgvs.description:
genomic HGVS description of the variant

Notes: Strongly encouraged for complex SVs (SV_type=CPX). 
Can be used to show uncertainty in SV breakends (g.(?_234567)_(345678_?)del)

hgvsc.description:
HGVS c. description of the variant (m. for mitochondrial, n. for noncoding)

Notes: This field is strongly encouraged if transcript is provided

hgvsp.description:
HGVS p. description of the variant

Notes: May use 'p.?' for non-coding variants

known_condition_name.description:
Free text of condition name. Variant/phenotype/inheritance in proband should be consistent with the condition.

Notes: - Condition name should match the OMIM or MONDO entry listed in line 26 for known disease genes.

linked_variant.description:
Second variant in recessive cases

Notes: genetic_findings_id of a second variant in the same gene to complete a compound het.

linked_variant_phase.description: Notes: optional description of phase if inheritance is unknown

items.description:
The method/assay(s) used to identify the candidate

Notes: Field to be used to capture method of discovery if experiment not currently supported by data model. (eg. >experiment_table_name.id_in_table)

notes.description:
Free text field to explain edge cases or discovery updates or list parallel experiment IDs or list parental allele balance when mosaic... etc.

Notes: Data collected in this section will be used to determine data model updates needed for future submission rounds.

items.description:
List of specific phenotypes (HPO IDs) explained by the condition associated with this variant/gene in cases of partial contribution

Notes: Field used when a genetic finding only partially explains participant phenotype and a second genetic finding is expected. For example, a syndromic case with a well-established pathogenic non-syndromic hearing loss variant. 
- For recesssive variants with partial contribution, only one of the linked variants needs to list HPO IDs explained by the linked candidate set.

participant_id.description:
Subject/Participant Identifier within project

Notes: RC submitted

phenotype_contribution.description:
Contribution of variant-linked condition to participant's phenotype.

Notes: - Each discovery in a recessive pair is considered full contribution.
- If the associated gene is not known ('candidate' on line 24), use Uncertain.
- If the associated gene is known but a second hit is missing, use either Uncertain or Full (depending on your confidence of the gene in the diagnosis)

pos.description:
Start position of the variant

Notes: this field uses VCF-style coordinates
pos.x-required-condition: CONDITIONAL (variant_type = SNV, variant_type = INDEL, variant_type = RE)

pos_end.description:
End position of SV

Notes: this field uses VCF-style coordinates

items.description: Public databases that this variant in this participant has been submitted by the RC.

ref.x-required-condition: CONDITIONAL (variant_type = SNV, variant_type = INDEL, variant_type = RE)

sv_type.description:
Notes: SV-vcf code descriptions:
BND = 'Translocation'
CNV = 'Copy Number Variant'
CPX  = 'Complex SV'
CTX  = 'Reciprocal chromosomal translocation'
DEL  = 'Deletion'
DUP  = 'Duplication'
INS  = 'Insertion'
INS:ME  = 'Mobile element insertion of unspecified ME class'
INS:ME:ALU  = 'Alu element insertion'
INS:ME:LINE1  = 'LINE1 element insertion'
INS:ME:SVA  = 'SVA element insertion'
INS:UNK  = 'Sequence insertion of unspecified origin'
INV  = 'Inversion'

transcript.description:
Text description of transcript overlapping the variant

Notes: Encourage to use MANE transcripts with version number.
- If your variant does not have MANE transcript, add most relevant transcript.

variant_inheritance.description:
Detection of variant in parents

Notes: - For duos where the variant is only confirmed to be not maternally or paternally inherited, use nonmaternal or nonpaternal, respectively.
- If the variant is found mosaic in a parent sample, report the patient allele balance in line 20 and use the free notes line 36 to report parental allele balance. 
- in scenario where variant is present in parent A and parent B's sequencing is not available (so cannot rule out possibility parent  B also carries the variant), this should be 'unknown', since line 34 (additional_family_members_with_variant) should also contain the info that parent A has this variant

variant_reference_assembly.description:
The genome build for identifying the variant position

Notes: Supports hg38 and future human references. If your pipeline uses a reference_assembly not currently listed, please contact the tiger team/DSA WG.

items.description:
Notes: SNV: single nucelotide variants
INDEL: short insertion/deletions (<50bp)
SV: structural variants
RE: repeat elements
